Where can I find your full shipping policy?
I can help you with both! Let me address each of your questions:
For help with your existing order, I can connect you with our Order Status tool that will pull up all your order details, including tracking information and current status. Would you like me to do that?
Regarding our shipping policy, we offer several delivery options depending on the product:
Free Standard Delivery - Mattresses ship via USPS® or UPS® ground shipping partners. Delivery timelines are estimated once your order is produced, and specific delivery dates cannot be scheduled with this method.
Doorstep/Curbside Delivery - For heavier items (over 150 lbs), we use this method where the item is placed at your front door or at the bottom of stairs. You can choose either a waived signature (contactless) or signature required (with appointment). This starts at $99 for the first large item, with a maximum charge of $198 per order.
In-Home Delivery & Setup - This optional white-glove service includes setup, appointment-based delivery on your chosen date, and the option to remove your old mattress. It starts at $249 and varies based on total weight. This service is nonrefundable.
We ship to anywhere in the continental United States, Alaska, and Hawaii (with higher shipping costs for Alaska and Hawaii).
